item.title: Week 10: Vikings at Packers
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: GB -2.5 · O/U 42.5 | Model GB 72% vs. market 57% | On paper Green Bay has the edge (Green Bay's defense ranks 5th in EPA per dropback, -0.02 allowed), while Minnesota's best counter is to hold them to field goals (Minnesota's defense ranks 1st in red-zone TD rate, 49% allowed). Under center, Jordan Love ranks 3rd of 31 in EPA per dropback and Kirk Cousins ranks 12th; x-factor: Matthew Golden gets 29% of Green Bay's targets and 39% of its air yards, and His WOPR (0.70) ranks 8th of 1211. Minnesota's pass defense ranks 3rd. The model favors Green Bay at 72%, mostly on passing matchup (4.2 pts) and home field (1.7 pts).
